description: Save your brand kit, or change one you already have: the brand's name, its colors, its fonts, light or dark as the usual look, a few words on how the brand sounds, a folder in your library, and its logos and pictures. Logos and pictures are pictures from your own Switch library, passed by their asset ids from list_my_assets or search_my_library; a file the person has not added yet goes in first with upload_media, then its returned asset id goes here. Saving with the name of a kit you already have updates that kit, and only the parts you pass change (a list you pass replaces that list). Your first kit becomes your default. Up to 24 colors, 12 fonts, 12 logos and 60 pictures per kit. Free.

colors.description: The brand colors, most important first.

role.description: What the color is for. Default accent.

default_mode.description: The usual look: light (white) or dark.

folder.description: Optional. One of your library folders by name or id; a new name makes a brand folder.

role.description: Headings, body text or code. Default body.

source_url.description: Optional https link where the font can be loaded, e.g. a Google Fonts link.

is_default.description: Optional. true makes this your default kit.

kit_id.description: Optional. The id of one of your kits to update, from list_brand_kits (lets you rename it).

logo_asset_ids.description: Asset ids of the logos, from your own library.

motion_notes.description: Optional. How the brand moves in video, up to 300 letters, e.g. "a juicy pour and bold type".

name.description: The brand name, up to 80 letters. Required for a new kit; with an existing name it updates that kit.

personality.description: Optional. One line on how the brand feels, up to 200 letters, e.g. "Bright and playful: a juicy pour and bold type".

picture_asset_ids.description: Asset ids of the brand pictures, from your own library.

share_with_team.description: Optional. true lets your team see this kit; false keeps it yours alone.

team_id.description: Optional. Which of your teams sees a shared kit, when you are on more than one.

voice_notes.description: Optional. How the brand sounds in words, up to 2000 letters in total, e.g. "warm, short sentences, no slang". Keep it to the voice; a long brand guide belongs in a file.

website.description: Optional. The brand's own website the kit was read from, a full https address.

name: save_brand_kit
title: Save Brand Kit
